name: Bookup
blurb: Bookup is a user-friendly note-taking application that streamlines the process with the use of markdown syntax.
description:
Bookup is a user-friendly note-taking application that streamlines the process
with the use of markdown syntax. Whether you're a student, professional,
or simply someone who loves to jot down ideas,
Bookup offers a seamless and efficient way to capture and organize your notes.

Bookup draws inspiration from the highly acclaimed Notes-up application.
We have taken the best aspects of Notes-up and enhanced them to create
an even more user-friendly note-taking experience.

Bookup is built in C for optimal speed and efficiency, offering quick
performance and a low memory footprint.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
